text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI can create art, write stories, and even compose music. These tools are powerful because they can produce new ideas quickly and help people who want to be creative. However, human creativity is still different from machine creativity. AI learns from data that people have already made, but humans use emotions, personal experiences, and imagination to create something truly original. Many people believe AI should be a helper, not a replacement. Used well, it can support artists and writers and open up exciting new possibilities for everyone.
